key_observations_html:
• Platform competition is increasingly distribution-led: partnership depth and channel reach are becoming stronger share drivers than technical differentiation alone. Related: IPX Announces Integration with Bridge, a Stripe Company, to Power Fiat On- and Off-Ramps on Its Tokenized IP Platform (The Defiant).
  • Scale tends to reinforce itself: once platforms establish issuer and liquidity depth, they often capture a disproportionate share of incremental distributed value. Related: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B (CoinTelegraph).
  • Custody and issuance integrations are moving rankings first: Stacks that win issuer workflow and distribution partnerships tend to climb platform rank ahead of category-level RWA totals. Related: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment (CoinDesk).
